history.sg_progress: The Department of Operational Support currently has two global system contracts offering hybrid vehicles and seven global system contracts for the supply of vehicles that comply with the latest Euro 5/6 emissions standards (carbon neutral). The seven contracts supply airport firefighting trucks, armoured passenger vehicles, minibuses, light passenger vehicles, and light and heavy trucks. The vehicles and equipment supplied under these contracts require ultra-low sulfur diesel of no more than 10 parts per million to operate correctly and become carbon neutral. These vehicles can be deployed to field missions wherever and whenever the required diesel fuel is available. The Department of Operational Support will continue to pursue the use of hybrid and carbon-neutral vehicles beyond existing contracts and to document its efforts to engage clients in identifying and meeting local constraints and requirements. The Administration considers this recommendation to have been implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
